From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Redwood trial: ClearMetrics POC kickoff & next steps

Hi Liam / Ava —

Great to meet you both today. Thanks for the time and for walking through ClearMetrics' ingestion flow and evaluation priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Why you're evaluating Redwood (summary)
- Need predictable latency for realtime enrichment (95th pct target < 250ms)
- Low per-token cost for high-volume embeddings/rerank jobs
- Tight security requirements for PII handling and auditability

What Redwood will deliver in the POC
1) Private trial on our sandbox tenant with a dedicated model variant tuned for short-response latency
2) A short checklist to validate telemetry and sample throughput under your sampling workload
3) Two-week window for usage with a mutual action plan to capture success criteria

Immediate asks / actions
- Liam: Confirm the S3 dataset path you want us to use for ingestion (placeholder: s3://clearmetrics-eval/sample-2026)
- Ava: Can your security lead share SOC2/infosec needs (or point us to the person)? We can provide a short evidence pack and a security contact.
- Redwood (Karthik / Aditya): I attached a short trial setup checklist and a mutual action plan we can edit together.

Attachments: redwood-trial-setup-checklist.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx

I'll check back next week if I don't hear anything — happy to be flexible on timeline if this slips. If it's helpful, we can also set up a 30-min office-hours style session with one of our SREs for hands-on setup.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform

Hi Liam —

I'm Karthik, engineering lead for trial onboarding at Redwood. Monica asked me to reach out because we've noticed zero ingestion and no telemetry from your sandbox tenant since the kickoff window opened.

Common quick blockers we can remove in a 30-minute call:
- IAM/policy misconfig on the S3 role (we can test with a temporary key)
- Sample format mismatches (CSV vs newline-delimited JSON)
- Network egress restrictions from your VPC

If helpful, we can:
1) Book a 30-min troubleshooting slot next week and I can run checks live with you
2) Fast-track a support ticket so our SREs can access logs and give an action plan
3) Offer one free extra week on the trial window if setup time is the blocker

We want to make the POC low-cost for you to evaluate. Quick options: Monday 26th 10:00–10:30 PST or Tuesday 27th 14:00–14:30 PST — tell us which works or propose another time and we'll accommodate.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
